items.description: Analyzes historical data using Eclipse Business Intelligence and Reports Tools (BIRT) technology. Betfair API is used to create BIRT charts and reports.
imWallet is an application that lets users to transfer file a network location to another cloud. This application uses the Dropbox API service.
